properties.note: APPROXIMATE / PROVISIONAL boundary for development and testing only: this is the published latitude/longitude EXTENT of the reserve (a box), not the notified Tiger Reserve boundary. Replace it by putting the official boundary at data/study_region/bandipur_official.geojson (or .kml / .shp).
